results.question: List the invoice numbers of all invoices that have not been paid in full.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT i.invoice_number FROM supplier_invoices i
LEFT JOIN supplier_payments p ON i.id = p.supplier_invoice_id
WHERE p.id IS NULL

results.question: Which suppliers have never been sent a purchase order?
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM suppliers s
LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON s.id = p.supplier_id
WHERE p.supplier_id IS NULL

results.question: For each supplier, how many deliveries arrived after the expected date? Highest first.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(g.receipt_date) AS deliveries_after_expected_date
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders p ON s.id = p.supplier_id
JOIN goods_receipts g ON p.id = g.po_id
WHERE julianday(g.receipt_date) > julianday(p.expected_date)
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY deliveries_after_expected_date DESC

results.question: List the supplier name and invoice number for every invoice not paid in full.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, i.invoice_number FROM supplier_invoices i
JOIN suppliers s ON i.supplier_id = s.id
WHERE i.amount_paid < i.total_amount
